summary: Join our comprehensive training course on Sustainability Metrics for Project Managers. Equip yourself with essential tools to drive sustainable project success.
lede: Sustainability metrics in project management measure environmental, social and economic effects to inform project decisions. This course is for project managers and sustainability professionals who need to select project-specific indicators, collect reliable data and explain results to stakeholders. It covers aligning metrics with ESG priorities, analyzing and visualizing data, and addressing data gaps or stakeholder concerns.
modules: Tools and Technologies for Data Collection
